hazards.evidence: Large patterned throw rug over carpet in the main walking area, with the near/right edge curled or folded up.
Black cord trails from the TV/lamp console area down across the carpet along the right-side walkway.
Central walking space is interrupted by the rug, footstool/ottoman, pet bed and toys, narrowing a clear walker path between seating and the right-side doorway/console.
Room appears dim overall with shadowed floor areas; task lighting near seating/walkways looks limited.
Pet bed and scattered pet toys sit on the central rug/walkway where a walker user would step or roll.
